back_sample.translation: This local tool rasterizes each page on an opaque white background and creates a new PDF/A-1b document with an sRGB output. It is a visual copy: searchable text, forms, links, signatures, metadata and accessibility structure are not preserved. Input is limited to 50 MB, 100 pages and 40 megapixels at the selected resolution. Sample output passed veraPDF during development, but this browser tool does not validate every output. Keep your original and verify the downloaded file with a PDF/A validator before relying on archive compatibility. Processing speed and practical limitations depend on the device; a computer is recommended.
